speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Monday. The copper has boiled. Twopence the horn, as it always is.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twopence. Fill it. I am in today.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Titus is at two, sir. Are you in Titus?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not in it. The Rose has the first Tamburlaine. I am not going there either.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the horn is the whole of your travelling. Mark me, do not leave it open where Gib can improve it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib is on the stair. I have moved him twice. He has moved himself back.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let him stay. I have a leaf to begin, and no name to put at the head of it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A nameless leaf is cheaper than a play you are not in. Climb if you are climbing, and take the horn with you.
